stories.summary: OpenAI has called on state lawmakers to bolster the existing AI safety bill, arguing that the current provisions are insufficient to address emerging risks. The company emphasized the need for clearer standards, stronger enforcement mechanisms, and broader stakeholder input to ensure responsible AI development.
stories.title: OpenAI urges California to tighten AI safety legislation

stories.summary: A recent study reveals that approximately one-third of web pages published since ChatGPT's debut were created using AI tools. The findings highlight the growing influence of AI in online content production.
stories.title: Study Finds AI-Generated Content Surge: A Third of Web Pages Since ChatGPT Launch Are AI-Written

stories.summary: The rapid growth of AI is outpacing traditional power infrastructure, forcing data centers to rethink energy sourcing and efficiency. Providers now face complex challenges balancing supply, demand, and sustainability.
stories.title: AI Boom Strains Data Center Power Supply, Complicating Energy Demand

stories.summary: The second part of a PyTorch profiling series explores performance optimizations, transitioning from basic linear layers to fused multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) for efficiency. It provides insights into reducing computational overhead in deep learning models.
stories.title: PyTorch Profiling Deep Dive: Optimizing from nn.Linear to Fused MLP

stories.summary: NVIDIA's new TensorRT Model Connect tool, now in public preview, enables developers to convert Hugging Face models to native C++ inference with just two commands. This streamlines AI deployment by reducing complexity and improving performance.
stories.title: NVIDIA Launches TensorRT Model Connect in Public Preview for Simplified AI Inference

stories.summary: New data suggests OpenAI is making strides in adoption among enterprise customers, closing the gap with rival Anthropic. The shift highlights growing competition in the AI assistant market for business applications.
stories.title: OpenAI Narrows Gap with Anthropic Among Business Users, Data Shows

stories.summary: A new ranking evaluates leading AI cloud providers like CoreWeave, Nebius, Lambda, Crusoe, and Groq based on published pricing and contracted power. The analysis highlights key differences in cost efficiency and infrastructure scalability for AI workloads.
stories.title: Top GPU Cloud Providers in 2026 Ranked by Pricing and Power Capacity

stories.summary: Anthropic has enhanced its Claude Security platform with the Claude Mythos 5 model, enabling enterprise teams to perform advanced vulnerability scanning without direct model access. The update aims to streamline security workflows while maintaining controlled access to AI capabilities.
stories.title: Anthropic Integrates Claude Mythos 5 into Claude Security for Enterprise Vulnerability Scanning

stories.summary: A new framework called SAM enables AI agents to operate in a peer-to-peer network without configuration or centralized trust. The system aims to enhance autonomy and security for decentralized AI collaboration.
stories.title: SAM (Sovereign Agent Mesh) Introduces Zero-Config, Zero-Trust P2P Network for AI Agents

stories.summary: A team has developed a text-to-speech AI model capable of responding in under 50 milliseconds, setting a new benchmark for real-time performance. The breakthrough enhances applications requiring instant voice synthesis, such as live translation or interactive assistants.
stories.title: Researchers Achieve Sub-50 Millisecond Response Time in Text-to-Speech AI Model

stories.summary: AutoFigure unveils a new AI-driven pipeline to automate the generation of scientific figures, enhancing document intelligence workflows. The system leverages agentic AI to streamline the creation and integration of visual data in research publications.
stories.title: AutoFigure Introduces Agentic Document Intelligence for Scientific Figure Creation

stories.summary: UPDF is introduced as a streamlined, resource-efficient alternative to Adobe's tools, designed to integrate seamlessly with AI agents and modern workflows. The software aims to cater to users seeking agility in document management and editing.
stories.title: UPDF Emerges as Lightweight Adobe Alternative for AI-Driven Workflows

stories.summary: A new study examines biases in language models by leveraging Direct Preference Optimization on Anthropic's HH-RLHF dataset, employing TRL and LoRA for efficient fine-tuning. The approach aims to improve alignment and transparency in AI systems.
stories.title: Researchers Audit Preference Biases in AI Models Using Direct Preference Optimization

stories.summary: NVIDIA introduced NeMo Guardrails, an open-source framework that enables developers to embed safety controls into large language models used in enterprise applications. The toolkit provides policy enforcement, content filtering, and compliance features to help organizations mitigate harmful outputs and meet AI governance standards.
stories.title: NVIDIA Launches NeMo Guardrails Toolkit for Enterprise AI Safety

stories.summary: A new open-source analysis breaks down three approaches to running AI agent loops, comparing their technical and economic trade-offs for providers. The report aims to help developers and businesses navigate the evolving landscape of AI agent architectures.
stories.title: Open-Source AI Guide Outlines Three Agent Loop Models and Their Economic Implications

stories.summary: The open‑source vllm inference engine for large language models released version 0.27.0rc1, featuring faster token streaming, expanded quantization support, and several stability improvements. The update is intended to simplify high‑throughput LLM deployment and is now available on GitHub.
stories.title: vllm 0.27.0 Release Candidate Boosts Performance and Adds New Features

stories.summary: The vLLM project has announced the second release candidate for version 0.27.0, introducing updates and improvements to its high-performance LLM inference and serving library. Users are encouraged to test the new features and report feedback before the stable release.
stories.title: vLLM Releases Version 0.27.0 Release Candidate 2

stories.summary: Liquid AI has released new LFM2.5-DSpark Draft models that accelerate decoding speeds by up to 3.18 times without altering model outputs. The update aims to improve efficiency in AI inference tasks.
stories.title: Liquid AI Unveils LFM2.5-DSpark Models for 3.18x Faster AI Decoding
